# Import Audio Files

iOS 15 +

## Notes

Imports the given audio files into the Music app.

## Syntax

~~~~text
importAudioFiles(files: <#Variable (Optional)#>, encode: <#Boolean (Optional)#>, enoder: <#Enumeration (WFImportAudioFilesEncoder) (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
importAudioFiles(files: , encode: , enoder: )
~~~~
